propositions: The bridge scheduler must switch from continuous re-dispatch to a single hourly cron entry (23 * * * *) now that RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS is disabled.
The cadence test must be retargeted to assert a uniform 60-minute gap, exactly one schedule entry, and a non-zero minute instead of the previous 40-minute three-entry pattern.

The CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm must be retuned from (threshold=1, evaluation_periods=1) to (threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2) to remain firable at an hourly cadence, preventing silent monitoring regression.

All workflow, test, and documentation references to 40-minute cadence must be updated to reflect 1-hour worst-case latency and hourly firing, except historical context explaining why the three-entry form existed.
